w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Redactor.

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Focus Group is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w5Mentions.name: The Editor
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Editor.
firstContext: 💛 You hold Contract Quill. It has signed three leases, two loans, and one terrible contract you still regret. The penmanship was always excellent. The judgment, less so. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon.
Travel 1 tile to trail edge.
Something moves out there — The Editor.
👁️ Mason freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
💬 Mason mutters: "Found a parcel by the hollow. Dried meat, clean water. That has Wren written all over it."

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: 💥 tiger's Rerun finds Everett — no dodging it.
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "🐅 Sweeps Week's turn"
Too close. The tiger's attention SNAPS to Everett — proximity overrules patience.
💥 tiger's Rerun finds Everett — no dodging it.
Everett's gear absorbs 5.
Tiger's Rerun hits Everett for 4.

w5Mentions.name: The Spoiler
w5Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ THE SPOILER! You're on your own.
firstContext: The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
You don't know what that was. A voiceover that knows too much. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
⚔ THE SPOILER! You're on your own.
You fling a handful of grit into its eyes. (pocket_sand: blinded)
Turn-based now. Tap a tile to move — speed is squares. Then act.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: It's settled. The village is calling it "The Big Bastard." The Codex keeps it.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
★ IDENTIFIED: Daylily Bud. Daylily. Tawny trumpet flowers, long buds. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
SYSTEM: Identification complete. You are 0.3% less lost.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A full seat. global standing, every wave faced, the deeds complete. The table rises when you enter. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 5 · Forage 5 · Craft 0 · Talk 17 · Explore 33 → 24 · capped)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TOTAL — COLD, CLEAN, EFFICIENT. YOU WOULD MAKE A MAGNIFICENT MACHINE. I MEAN THAT AS THE HIGHEST COMPLIMENT AND SLIGHTLY AS A THREAT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; promises kept; the relay carried faithfully. The dark road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ Owen Smith reached into the light and the light reached back — person and machine, two caretakers, holding the channel open between them both ways. The village endures, and the conversation does not end.
